cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then it should survive a more informative test.

mechanism: A treats its baking pupil equal score as an unfinished lesson and imposes successively altered tiebreakers with cleaning at stake.
confusable: Not only disliking a draw: A gives a specific new contest rule and actual loser penalty, including after B refuses more cake.
comparison: Baking assessment converted to word game versus dinner-bill equality converted to descriptive contest.
